title: Venezuelan-Style Pabellon Sandwich
description: A flavorful sandwich inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, featuring crispy bread, seasoned beef, and melted cheese.

ingredients.name: Melted cheese
ingredients.notes: shredded cheese, such as mozzarella or queso fresco

ingredients.name: Venezuelan-style seasoning
ingredients.notes: available at Latin American grocery stores or online

instructions: Season the beef with salt, pepper, and Venezuelan-style seasoning.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set it aside to rest.
Add the sliced plantains to the skillet and cook until they're caramelized and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading melted cheese on two slices of bread, then adding the beef, plantains, and cilantro.
Top with the remaining bread slices and serve immediately.
